900.longDesc:
Something terrible is happening.

I need to get to my apartment in Brookvale and find my {Partner}, {PartnerName}.

901.longDesc: The apartment is a the end of the block in Brookvale. God I hope my {Partner} is ok.

902.longDesc: {PartnerNameShort} isn't here, I need to find out where {PartnerSex}'s gone

903.longDesc: My {Partner} {PartnerNameShort} left a note saying {PartnerSex} went to the hospital to help out. Nearest Hospital is in Canal Park.

904.longDesc: This hospital was where {PartnerName} said {PartnerSex}'d be.

905.longDesc:
One of the nurses said that they might've moved people to the Stadium, including {PartnerName}.

Travel through Newtown and Uptown to get there.

906.longDesc: The soldier at the gate told you to report to the registration officer at Stadium. Perhaps they have information on where {PartnerName} is.

907.longDesc: The list says {PartnerName} was relocated, find out where they sent {PartnerSexAddress}.

908.longDesc: Find someone in the stadium grounds that knows what happened to {PartnerName}

909.shortDesc: Meet Barry in the Mens Room
909.longDesc: Barry asked you to meet him in the maintennance room behind the mens room at the Stadium.

910.longDesc: Talk to Barry to find out what the plan is.

911.longDesc: Barry wants you to find out what the Homeland Environmental Risk Control (HERC) is up to at the Stadium.

912.shortDesc: Return to Barry with the info
912.longDesc: You have information that says that the relocations are to Union Park in Uptown, go and tell Barry.

913.shortDesc: Go to the park in Uptown
913.longDesc: All evidence points to {PartnerName} being at Union Park in Uptown. Go and meet Barry there!

914.longDesc: Use the key to break into the HERC compound at Union Park and find {PartnerName}

915.longDesc: Use the key to break into the HERC compound at Union Park and find {PartnerName}

916.longDesc: Go to the Docks and find a boat

917.longDesc: Go to the Military Base in Waterside and find some explosives.

918.longDesc: We're going to need blocks of C4, blasting caps and a timer.

919.longDesc: Go to the wall with Jack and prepare for the final assault.

001.longDesc:
Ed is trying to get through the fence, it's the only way into the Brookvale and my apartment.
He needs bolt cutters to cut his way in.
He said Ray at number 12 has some.

002.longDesc: Hank the gun shop owner needs me to find his rifle and bolt group for it. They're in his apartment, number 202, down the street from his Canal Park shop. He gave me his neighbours key to get in.

003.longDesc: Ray says that he returned Ed's boltcutters. I should go and tell Ed he must have them.

004.longDesc: Ed gave me the key to his garage at number 14. The bolt cutters should be in there somewhere.

006.longDesc: Darnel says he can make you something to smash some skulls if you find him the materials.

007.longDesc: Darnel has plans for something pretty nasty I think if you can find the materials.

008.longDesc: Darnel has plans for a suppressed pistol, not sure where he learned to make something like this.

009.longDesc: Union Security staff are stuck at their offices in Newtown. They need the weapons from their gun cage, an employee named Richards stole the key and headed to Uptown. Find the key and return to Union Security.

010.longDesc: Get the key off Richards' body and return to Union Security in Newtown to open the gun cage.

011.longDesc:
Kelly, the store clerk at Stan's General Foods in Brookvale has lost her glasses, she can't go anywhere without them.

She said she dropped them on the floor.

015.longDesc: Jeb, Paul and their 'friends' are stranded with their van not working. They need gas and parts to get it running again.

016.longDesc: Directions to the cabin: Go left, up, turn right at the pond. Go past the old fence and take the path up. Go left and take the second path. Look for the can on a stick.

017.longDesc: Find 4 blood samples on corpses in the Whistler's Forest nature reserve. Dr.Phillip Best thinks he can find out more about what's going on from that.

states.content: Proceed through the door behind me and speak to the registration officer, {Formal}.
Make your way onto the field with the rest of the survivors.

Sorry {Formal}, this is a quarantine area, we can't allow you to leave.

Speak with the registration officer over there and move onto the field with everyone else.

Give your name to the registration officer if you haven't already, {Formal}.

We're gathering names so we can eventually get those affected by the outbreak back together.

Ok {Title} {last} we'll add you to the registration.

If you're looking for someone, you can check the list of names posted on the wall behind me.

They brought me and a few of the others in from Canal Park, you know, the hospital there.

I went there looking for my brother, he'd been in a coma for years before all this started, lucky bastard.

He was long gone before I even got there, the place was crawling with those things.

I fought my way in only to find him in pieces. Then the army showed up and dragged us here.

What's happening out there? We're being kept in the dark here.

I keep asking the military guys what's going on and they keep ignoring me.

I'm sure it's under control...I mean it has to be if people are still arriving.

Yeah, it means people are being brought in by the army, that's what it means.

I'd pulled a 48 hour shift and was resting in one of the vacant rooms when one of the other nurses came down and woke me up.

Something was going on in the upper levels, we just booked it and got the hell out of there.

Ran to Newtown and then the Army found me and brought me here.

Probably saved my life.

I'm just thankful to be alive.

I was on the fourth floor of the hospital in Canal Park when everything went crazy, I shouldn't have made it. I tried to get as many people out as I could, you know.

Some were just too slow.

{PartnerName}? That's her bunk right there.

She got 'relocated' by HERC last night.

Look, I'll tell you straight, this place is locked down they're gathering us up here. You want to find your {Partner} you'll follow me.

Meet me in the maintennance room through the mens room.
states.contentActive:
Meet me in the maintennance room in the back of the men's bathroom, I'll be there in a minute so it doesn't look suspicious.

We need to hurry before they do another round of 'relocations'.
states.contentComplete:
Meet me in the maintennance room in the back of the men's bathroom, I'll be there in a minute so it doesn't look suspicious.

We need to hurry before they do another round of 'relocations'.

states.content:
Good, we can speak freely here.

They took my wife in the first round of relocations.

Didn't say where, didn't say why.

I trust the Army, but I want to know what HERC is up to. They have no good reason to separate us.

HERC has a command post or something set up on the other side of the stadium. The door behind me leads to service areas all around the stadium, you'll be able to get in through there.

Get me some info and I'll give you a way out of here.
states.contentActive: Go and find out what HERC is up to, then come and see me. Hopefully there's some leads on where they're taking people.
states.contentComplete: They're taking them to Union Park?

states.content:
They shot at you?! Jesus Christ. This' worse than I thought.

They're at the park you say, ok, you go. I'll leave in a few hours, so they don't catch wind of us escaping.

There's a sewer access in the boiler room at the end of the access tunnels, here's the key. It leads out to the street.

Meet me at Harrison and Harrison, I've got a way into the park from there.
states.contentActive:
Good luck, meet me at Harrison and Harrison in Uptown.

Go, get outta here and be careful!
states.contentComplete:
Good luck, meet me at Harrison and Harrison in Uptown.

Go, get outta here and be careful!

states.content: Head inside to the stadium lobby, {Formal}.

Don't loiter near the bathrooms, {Formal}.

We can't have people gathering in groups around the bathrooms.

Do your business and return to the field.

Oh baby, you're alive. I...I...Oh god you found me. I got bitten at the hospital, they were doing tests on people and I never saw them again, I heard gunshots, what...get me out, quickly.

The keys are on the wall.
states.contentActive: Quickly, the keys! Gotta get out, gotta get out.
states.contentComplete: Quickly, the keys! Gotta get out, gotta get out.

states.content:
Name is Jack, nice to meet you.

I fought my way here for days, looking for some way off the mainland.

HERC bastards sank every boat to contain the infection.

I heard a radio transmission and started travelling here, started in Glendale, went all the way through, Whistler's Grove, Jonestown, Fort Tran and then here.

Nothing to show for it. Nothing at all. Except these other survivors and handful of supplies.

The only boats left are the ones they have docked on Union Island.

Problem is they dropped that huge concrete wall right over the entrance to the bridge.

If you can find something to blow a hole in it, we can get out of here.

One of the locals here says there's a military base at Waterside, just north of here, maybe you can find something there.
states.contentActive:
Go to the Military Base in Waterside.

See if you can't find something to blow our way onto that island.
states.contentComplete:
Go to the Military Base in Waterside.

See if you can't find something to blow our way onto that island.

states.content:
The only boats left are the ones they have docked on Union Island.

Problem is they dropped that huge concrete wall right over the entrance to the bridge.

If you can find something to blow a hole in it, we can get out of here.

One of the locals here says there's a military base at Waterside, just north of here, maybe you can find something there.
states.contentActive: Did you find enough explosives to blow a hole in that wall?
states.contentComplete:
Nice work finding those explosives, wasn't sure you had it in you. Let's getting to make our push, take that island and get out of here.

Take this, I lifted it off some heavy set HERC soldier the other day, it's not as reliable as my AK here, but you might like it.

states.content: I'll head out and rig the explosives, meet me at the wall.
states.contentActive: You go ahead, I'll meet you out at the wall.
states.contentComplete: You go ahead, I'll meet you out at the wall.

states.content: Ok.

Don't come any closer.

Speak to Jack if you gotta speak to someone.

Jack found me Whistler's grove, he was hunting around the gas station there where I was holed up.

Figured it'd safer if we stuck together.

Some crazy story he has, he survived a helicopter crash you know!?

Hey, Jack saved my butt more than a few times, I've only known the guy for a few days.

I was fighting my way out of Jonestown, guy comes tearing through with an RPG over his shoulder, blowing those things to pieces.

Wanna rely on someone to keep you alive? Jack is your man.

Good to meet someone else with the stones to stand up to these things!

I tell you what, I've got some ideas for some little tools to give us an advantage over these monsters.

You find me the materials and I'll kit you out to smash some skulls.
states.contentActive: Did you find the things I asked for?
states.contentComplete:
Nice job, I filed down that weight and put it inside the pipe for you, should give it a nice swing.

I've got some more ideas if you're willing to find what I need.

states.content:
How's that pipe working out?

I've got a great idea this time, something nasty. Reaaaal nasty <Darnel's eye has a twitch about it and he smiles broadly>.

It's a pretty simple build, but I think you'll like it, here's the list.
states.contentActive: Got those parts?
states.contentComplete:
Nice job!

Now careful with this thing, those nails looked pretty darn rusty.

I found plans for one more thing in my uhhh 'handbook', going to need more materials though.

These might be tougher to find.

states.content:
Alright, here's the list. I need these things exactly. With this thing, they won't even hear you coming.

You'll be like some kinda ninja or somesuch.
states.contentActive: Did you find everything?
states.contentComplete:
Here she is, my finest work yet!

You'll be poppin' heads in silence in no time.

I'm gonna get back to work, gotta keep myself busy. Don't worry about me, I'll be fine. Made it through 3 tours in 'nam no problems, think I can outlast a few shamblers

states.content: Just glad I could help, {Friendly}.

Oh god, please help, I've been stuck in here since it all started. I must have dropped my glasses on the floor somewhere in the store in all the confusion.

I'm blind as a bat without them.

If you can find them, is it ok if I come with you?
states.contentActive:
I can't see anything without my glasses.

I must have dropped them on the floor somewhere in the store.
states.contentComplete: Ok, I'll stay here.

states.content: Ok, I'll stay here, thanks for finding my glasses.
Head into the saferoom downstairs, there's a way into the park from there. Those HERC soldiers are going to be looking for us.

Here's the sewer key, I cleaned this building for years until they put me out of a job. Had my own copy of the keys though.

I'm too old to be climbing around down there, you go.

Get in, find your {Partner} and get out. Take some of those bastards with you if you get the chance.
states.contentActive: Go through the sewer and into the HERC outpost, you'll find your partner in there, I'm sure of it.
states.contentComplete:
Oh, you found {PartnerSexAddress}. I'm happy for you, I really am.

You kids go, get out of here. I'm going to see if I can find my wife amongst the dead.

Head to the Docks, get off the mainland if you can. Good luck, friend.

states.content:
You've got weapons, great. You might be able to help us out.

Head up stairs and talk to Stephens, he'll fill you in.

Nice job finding the key, man.

Hopefully now we can get organised and head to the Stadium with everyone else.

I hear that's where they're evac'ing everyone.

1: Head upstairs, Stephens is in charge.

states.content:
That bastard Richards left us to die here. Left us for dead. I'll wring his damn neck if I ever get out of here.

Swear to god.

Richards' dead? Good.

Rat bastard. We might make it out of here after all. Thanks for helping us out with the cage.

We're in a spot of trouble here, {Older}.

You see, Richards, one of our new employees lost it and ran off with a bunch of our weapons.

He was headed towards Uptown, not sure what he was thinking.

The deal is, he has our gun cage key, without it we're defenseless.

Can you get it back?
states.contentActive: If you've got the key back, go ahead and help yourself to whatever you want in the cage.
states.contentComplete:
Appreciate your help there, stranger.

Go ahead and help yourself to your pick from the cage.

states.content: Thanks again for the help, we'll get out of here once we get ourselves organised. Feel free to rest up here as long as you need to, it's the least we can do.

Oh you're not here to rob me?

You'd think that I'd have the arsenal to hold them off but there was too many, people looking real wild eyed.

I'm not going anywhere without my Daddy's rifle and bolt.

They're in my gun cabinet in my apartment down the street, number 202. My place is boarded up, take this spare key my neighbor gave me, it'll get you in.
states.contentActive:
I told you I'm not going anywhere without my Daddy's rifle. Find it and the bolt.

Apartment 202, remember.
states.contentComplete: Great! Thanks, let's get outta here.

states.content: Thanks so much, this should help me survive for a while at least. Good luck out there.

We've been here since it started.

I was on break and heard trucks pull up outside, soldiers poured out of the back of them and into the hospital

At first it was just commotion, then...gunshots. So we hid in the storage cupboard.

The soldiers missed us and cleared out

When we emerged, there were just dead people everywhere so we holed up here.

I haven't seen your {Partner}, {Formal}.

But I did see what happened to everyone else who wasn't lucky enough to be in this room.

They were herding people onto trucks at gunpoint to take them to the Stadium for quarantine.

I'd start looking there. Just head north through Newtown and then Uptown to get there.
states.contentActive:
I'm pretty sure your {Partner} will be at the Stadium.

It was the Army that took everyone away, so I'd normally think they'd be safe, but there was gunfire going off everywhere.
states.contentComplete: Good luck.

states.content:
The King has what you need, friend.

Understand that the King can only accept CASH. In these uncertain times, friend, money is...uhhh...King.

No trade-ins, no loans, no credit. It's all cash cash cash, baby.

See something you like, go ahead and pick it out.

Hey there...friend.

My brother and our other...friends here ran into some car troubles. There's a small town just down the road a smidge, you wouldn't mind goin' in and picking up some gas, a fan belt and some tools now would you?

We'd go but, we have to uhhhh protect our friends here.

I'm sure our new friends can make it worth your while.
states.contentActive: Just keep heading east, the town is down the dirt track here, can't miss it. Remember we need gas and a new fan belt, the old one is shot.
states.contentComplete:
Heeeey, thanks friend.

These are exactly what we needed, guess we'll be on our way.

states.content:
Talk to my brother, friend.

Perhaps you can uhhh, help us out here, we're in a real pickle.
<Clarence doesn't respond, he seems very on edge and gestures you away>

Oh thank goodness.

You saved our skins there, {Older}.

We broke down here a few hours ago and then those bumpkins set upon us out of the woods.

Thanks for getting the things we need to fix the van, keep the money they took from us, you deserve it, hopefully it's useful for you.
<Fern looks down and away from you, glancing over at Paul>

Thankyou so much.

Lord knows what they would have done with us.

We appreciate your help, you've saved us.

Did Lisa send you? How'd you find me out here. What's the situation in Union City, soldier? Hmm! Tell me.

Not a talker, huh? Ok, very well. I've been working on some improvised 'hunting tools', if you're going to be part of my platoon, you'd best be equipped for the job!

Thankyou so much.

Lord knows what they would have done with us.

We appreciate your help, you've saved us.

Oh {Formal}, you have to help me.

It's my brother, Terry. He went off his meds a few weeks ago and disappeared. Then this whole thing happened and now I don't have a hope of finding him on my own.

I think he's probably gone to his cabin out in the Nature Reserve.

If I give you the directions do you think you could look for him?

Here's how to get to the cabin: Go left, up, turn right at the pond. Go past the old fence and take the path up. Go left and take the second path. Look for the can on a stick.
states.contentActive: Like I said, just go left, up, then turn right at the pond. Go past the old fence and take the path up. Go left and take the second path. Look for the can on a stick.
states.contentComplete:
Oh you found him, thank god.

He's staying out there? Ok, he knows how to handle himself I guess, I'm just happy he's alive.

states.content:
I left the city and abandoned the HERC outpost I was assigned to. They're doing terrible things to civilians, unspeakable things, I mean, I'm just a hematologist. I didn't want to be a part of it.

I'm trying to find some way to fix this, the infection originated out here somewhere and I think that maybe, just maybe, the answers are out here too - in the blood.

Help me gather samples from the corpses out in this area, would you?
states.contentActive: I need at least 4 sample vials from corpses in the Whistler's Forest area. Your help might help me get closer to finding out what caused all this.
states.contentComplete: Excellent work, these samples should help us get closer to finding out what's started all this. When we initiated the martial law, we took over the clinics first. Take this key, it's to the offices in the clinic in Uptown, hopefully you can find something of use there.

states.content: Thanks for your help, I wish I could tell you more but it could take weeks to analyse these samples. Good luck!

The military put this fence up a few days ago, blocking the road to Brookvale then abandoned it.

We need something to cut our way through.

I know Ray at number 12 has a pair of bolt cutters, I borrowed them last month. Hurry!
states.contentActive: Go talk to Ray at number 12, he has a pair for sure.
states.contentComplete: Go talk to Ray at number 12, he has a pair for sure.

states.content:
What? I have them?

Hmmmm maybe I didn't return them. Here's the key to my garage, go find them for yourself and bring 'em back.
states.contentActive:
Did you find those boltcutters yet?

It's the only way we're getting through here.
states.contentComplete:
Great, hand them over.

Finally we can make our way to safety.

states.content:
I'm sorry, I just moved in, are you one of the neighbours? I guess that doesn't matter now. You're safe here.

This all started a few days ago, people just...started killing each other. The ones they killed didn't stay dead.

< He takes a second to compose himself >

Stay here and rest up. I've got Sarah and Peter from next door staying in my room upstairs. You're welcome sleep on the floor here if you need to.

Damned shuffling rambling things.

They still down stairs?

I'm too old for this business.
states.contentActive:
I'm staying right here, damnit.

I was born in this here house and this' where I'll die.

states.content:
What's that? That bastard Ed sent you, huh?

Bolt Cutters! He borrowed them weeks ago and never returned them!

They're probably next door in his stinking garage!

Go tell him that he's still got the damn things.
states.contentActive: What? I told you, Ed never returned my damn bolt cutters. They're probably in his garage.
states.contentComplete: What? I told you, Ed never returned my damn bolt cutters. They're probably in his garage.

states.content: What, go away.

Oh, you're not one of them, thank god.

Jackson was kind enough to take us in, he's secured the place as best he could, I don't think they're getting in here any time soon.

My husband has lost it, he wants to leave, I think it's best we stay here and wait this thing out, right?

Anyway, good luck finding your way.

1: We can't leave yet, honey we need to wait it out.

states.content:
<The man looks visibly shaken>

Ooooh god, oh god, oh god. Why won't they stop. Why is this happening, they already took my kids what do they waaant FROM ME!

We have to leave, we have to leave. The bags are packed and ready. We can go, we can go now.
states.contentActive:
I'm staying right here, damnit.

I was born in this here house and this' where I'll die.

1: *sobbing* Oh god, we're dead. We're dead.

What the hell is
going on here?!

Damnit, empty.
Best go further into town.
Alright, it's just the next block over.
{PartnerSexStart}'s not here. Maybe {PartnerSex} left a note.
The hospital? That place is going to be a mess.
That's the stadium down there, a few blocks more yet.
Looks like Richards didn't make it.
Damnit, road to Uptown is blocked, looks like it's the subway route.
Hank's rifle is somewhere amongst this mess.

Home. God I hope
{PartnerName} is safe.

Relocated!
What the hell does that mean?

That's {PartnerNameShort}'s bag.
Where the hell is {PartnerSex}

Oh my god.

I need to get
home to {PartnerNameShort}.

1.text:
QUARANTINE NOTICE: 

This facility has been QUARANTINED by Homeland Environmental Risk Control.
Attempts to leave the quarantine zone will be met with SEVERE CONSEQUENCES.


Any persons who have been in contact with the affected should present themselves to the nearest HERC Emergency station.

2.text: Well that quarantine went well, HUH!?.

3.text:
PATIENT: Con Johnson.
D.O.B: 8-8-1979

ADDRESS: 1250 8th Avenue, Glendale.

Patient walked into emergency on May 15 showing signs of severe fatigue.
On inspection by Dr.Burkman, patient's BP and HR were slightly elevated, hydration was severely lacking. Suspected that patient walked from his home in Glendale.

Patient had what appears to be an animal bite on his left calf. Possible rabies is present.

4.text:
Nurses,
Had a patient walk into the hospital today, literally walk, from Glendale. It's 100 miles from here! His shoes were torn apart, clothing ragged. He looked at deaths door.

On top of all that he was nursing a bite on his leg. It didn't appear to bleed much, though it showed some strange coagulation around the site.

Keep an eye on him please, something going on there!

6.text:
Tony,

I called the pizza place but got some really weird answer so I'm going down there to get the pizza.

7.text:
Dave,

You aren't here. You gave me your word you would be there for me.

You lied. How am I going to get out of here? I HATE YOU!

8.text:
Dear Mommy,

Nana says I have to write goodbi to you but I dont no why I keep hearing screams and I hope the pepol are ok

I miss you Mommy!

Julia

9.text:
Tiffany, I love you.
Oh God what wouldn't I give to be able to tell you this one last time.
To hold you in my arms; I would give myself to Death if that assured your safety. I wonder if you're thinking about me right now. If you ever find this Tiffany, know that I love you
- Carson

10.text:
Dear Annoying Prick,
With this whole thing going on, I thought you might stop trying to get in my pants. But no. You kept at it. I wish I could just kill you, but I'm too nice for that. So I'm sabotaging your little escape plan.

Have fun with your burning boat.
- Violet <3

11.text:
Dear Jenny,
If you're reading this, I fear my life will soon end. I know the chances of you finding this note are very slim. Please don't worry about me. Just try to get the kids out of Union City. Know that I love you and the kids dearly. Not a moment goes by I don't think about you.
- John

12.text:
Roxanne,

Went looking for Tommy at his school. I found him, he was with friends, all turned into those 'things'. Bit me good in the hand.

DON'T COME LOOKING FOR US.

I'm sorry, I tried.

Love, John.

13.text: Release the souls of the blessed and the damned. I am not your keeper. Oh God forgive me, for I have sinned.

14.text:
The flaws in the air are excelling, expanding, the rain is turning more sour by the day, I long for a home, for peace.

I'm free now, from this wretched hell.

-Valentine

15.text:
Dear Carly,
Jessie left, she went East after hearing that broadcast, the old house is bad news, there is alot of them around it now so I set out North, I hear it's much safer up there. I hope you understand I thought alot of you and I wish you never went back for Jake, watch yourself.
Love Curtis

16.text: It 's the government. I know it's the government. It's always the government. They want to kill us all. They will declare martial law and erase our rights. They are in cahoots with the aliens and communists. I've always known it. Who's the fool now?

17.text:
This place is not safe! Nowhere is safe!

You will die just like the rest of us. Abandon hope. Abandon god like he abandoned us.

18.text:
Honey,
They closed the store with me in it here! It's been days and all I've heard is screaming.

I'm fairly sure no-one is coming for me, I guess this is goodbye.

I love you, baby.

19.text:
Whats goin' on first 'Cult murders' then 'cannibals' now they tell everyone to go here or there telling different people different things.

God, the army isnt even giving their own soldiers orders. WHAT THE HELL IS HAPPENING?

20.text:
Note:
Morality Today's not the day for that. It's every man for himself now. Survival instinct overrides compassion and reason. Don't hesitate behind the trigger- those things just aren't people anymore. We can cry when this is all over.

22.text:
Hey Jon,

I've got a store up online in return for all the artwork you used in that vampire Future Splash game you're making.

You can check it out here: tinyurl.com/boothtique

If you could link to it in the game somehow that'd be great.

Cheers, Boothy.

24.text:
Roger,
Heading north, heard it was safe. I dont know though. Ive been to so many 'Safe Havens' that were overrun by Them. I dont know what to do anymore. the kids are scared. Im not the religious one, but i tell yeah, Ive prayed so much my hands hurt. Hope it helps. God be with us?
Good Luck, Aaron

25.text:

Remember what I told you and always respect, protect and obey your father and always remember that I love you so much. I am going to leave you forever because I am too sick to go on. Bless you my Son and when your time comes to go. You will find me waiting for you.
Mom.

Next chump who knocks at my door looking for a place to stay has to pay up. I can't afford to give everyone a free pass, especially after that last guy turned on me in the middle of the night. --Eli

28.text: To anyone who reads this: I see it everywhere. I can't get rid of it. It tells me to kill and I do, hoping it goes away. But no mattter how many of those things I kill it comes back. Words, thoughts, death, always in my head. I end it all to protect people like you and to stop it. Goodbye.
